content:
Question: How do I charge my Ather 450X at home?

Answer: The Ather 450X can be charged using the Ather Dot home charger (included with the scooter) or at any Ather Grid public charging station. To charge at home, plug the Ather Dot into a standard 5A or 15A socket. A full charge from 0–100% takes approximately 5 hours 45 minutes on a 15A socket. The charging port is located under the seat on the left side.

Question: How fast can I charge the Ather 450X at a public station?

Answer: The Ather 450X supports fast charging at Ather Grid public stations. A fast charge from 0–80% takes approximately 1 hour 10 minutes at an Ather Grid point. Ather Grid is India's largest two-wheeler fast-charging network with 1,800+ charging points across 100+ cities. You can locate the nearest point via the Ather app or dashboard navigation. Ather Grid charging is free for Ather owners for the first year after purchase (One plan); after that it is billed at ₹1.5/Wh.

Question: What is the battery range of the Ather 450X?

Answer: The Ather 450X has a 2.9 kWh lithium-ion battery and offers a certified range of 146 km (IDC) in Eco mode. In real-world city conditions, riders typically achieve 85–105 km per charge depending on riding style, load, and terrain. Warp mode (highest performance) reduces range to approximately 70–80 km. The battery is IP67 rated for water and dust resistance.

Question: What is the battery warranty on the Ather 450X?

Answer: The Ather 450X battery is warranted for 3 years or 30,000 km, whichever comes first. The warranty covers manufacturing defects and significant capacity degradation. It is void if the battery has been tampered with, used with non-authorised chargers, or damaged due to accidents.

Question: What is covered under the Ather 450X vehicle warranty?

Answer: Ather provides a 3-year or 30,000 km vehicle warranty (whichever comes first) covering the frame, fork, suspension, and motor. Wear-and-tear items such as tyres, brake pads, and brake shoes are not covered. Warranty is void if the scooter is modified, involved in an accident, or serviced by an unauthorised service centre.

Question: How often does the Ather 450X need servicing?

Answer: Ather recommends a service every 6 months or 5,000 km, whichever comes first. The first free service is at 750 km or 1 month. Unlike petrol scooters, the 450X has no engine oil, spark plugs, or air filter to replace. Regular maintenance covers brake inspection, tyre pressure check, throttle and brake cable check, and software updates. Always use an authorised Ather service centre — do not take the scooter to a general mechanic.

Question: What are the riding modes on the Ather 450X?

Answer: The Ather 450X has four riding modes: Eco, Ride, Sport, and Warp. Eco mode limits top speed to 45 km/h and maximises range. Ride mode is for regular city riding with a top speed of 60 km/h. Sport mode offers increased acceleration and a top speed of 80 km/h. Warp mode is the highest performance mode with a top speed of 90 km/h and 0–60 km/h acceleration in 5.1 seconds. Warp mode is only available on the 450X Pro variant.

Question: Does the Ather 450X support OTA updates and smartphone connectivity?

Answer: Yes. The Ather 450X supports over-the-air (OTA) software updates delivered via Wi-Fi, installed automatically when the scooter is parked and connected. The scooter has a built-in 7-inch touchscreen dashboard with Android Auto support, turn-by-turn navigation, call and music controls, and real-time tyre pressure monitoring. The Ather app (iOS and Android) allows remote monitoring of battery level, trip history, and charging status via Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.

Question: What are the variants and prices of the Ather 450X?

Answer: The Ather 450X is available in two variants. The standard 450X starts at approximately ₹1,30,000 ex-showroom (varies by city after FAME II subsidy). The 450X Pro adds Warp mode and extra connectivity features, starting at approximately ₹1,45,000 ex-showroom. Prices vary by state due to different subsidy structures. Ather also offers financing through partner banks with EMIs starting from approximately ₹3,500/month.

Question: What safety features does the Ather 450X have?

Answer: The Ather 450X includes: Combined Braking System (CBS) for front and rear brake coordination, IP67-rated battery for water and dust resistance, geo-fencing alerts and theft detection via the Ather app, tow alerts, and a crash detection system. The scooter also has a side-stand motor cut-off (motor turns off if side stand is lowered while riding). Tyres are tubeless MRF on 12-inch alloy wheels.

content:
Question: How can I purchase the Ather 450X or book a test ride?

Answer: You can book a test ride through the Ather website (atherenergy.com) or the Ather app — test rides are free and available at all Ather Experience Centres. To purchase, visit any Ather Experience Centre or order online. A ₹2,000 fully refundable booking amount is required to confirm the order. Delivery typically takes 2–4 weeks. Ather Experience Centres are present in 100+ cities across India.
